verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions general-ledger or journal-entry export, or any QuickBooks or Xero integration. The only related items are a generic claim of connecting to 'dozens of other applications' and a REST API with webhooks. Those are adjacent claims and developer building blocks, not a documented automatic accounting sync.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero
